Row2 * col3: (14)*1 + (-10)*0 + (20)*1 = 14+0+20 = 34

Row3 * col1: (32)*1 + (-36)*1 + (-48)*0 = 32 -36 +0 = -4
Row3 * col2: (32)*0 + (-36)*0 + (-48)*1 = 0+0-48 = -48
Row3 * col3: (32)*1 + (-36)*0 + (-48)*1 = 32+0-48 = -16

So P20 = 
[-56, 16, -8]
[4, 20, 34]
[-4, -48, -16]

A21 =

[-1, 0, 0]

Row2 * col2: (4)*(-1) + (20)*0 + (34)*0 = -4 +0+0 = -4
Row2 * col3: (4)*0 + (20)*0 + (34)*(-1) = 0+0-34 = -34

Row3 * col2: (-4)*(-1) + (-48)*0 + (-16)*0 = 4+0+0 = 4
Row3 * col3: (-4)*0 + (-48)*0 + (-16)*(-1) = 0+0+16 = 16

So P21 = 
[-16, 56, 8]
[-20, -4, -34]
[48, 4, 16]

A22 = 
[-1, 0, 0]
[0, 0, 1]
[0, 1, 0]

Compute P22 = P21 * A22:

Row1 * col1: (-16)*(-1) + (56)*0 + (8)*0 = 16
Row1 * col2: (-16)*0 + (56)*0 + (8)*1 = 8
Row1 * col3: (-16)*0 + (56)*1 + (8)*0 = 56

Row2 * col1: (-20)*(-1) + (-4)*0 + (-34)*0 = 20
Row2 * col2: (-20)*0 + (-4)*0 + (-34)*1 = -34
Row2 * col3: (-20)*0 + (-4)*1 + (-34)*0 = -4

Row3 * col2: (48)*0 + (4)*0 + (16)*1 = 16
Row3 * col3: (48)*0 + (4)*1 + (16)*0 = 4

So P22 =

A23 = 
[1, 0, -1]

Row1 * col3: (16)*(-1) + (8)*0 + (56)*0 = -16 +0+0 = -16

Row2 * col2: (20)*0 + (-34)*(-1) + (-4)*1 = 0 +34 -4 = 30
Row2 * col3: (20)*(-1) + (-34)*0 + (-4)*0 = -20

Row3 * col2: (-48)*0 + (16)*(-1) + (4)*1 = 0 -16 +4 = -12
